# Security policy

## Supported versions

Until sandboxPkg is on CRAN, only the development version on `main` gets fixes. After that, the latest CRAN release
does.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't open a public issue. Use GitHub's private reporting instead: on the
[Security tab](https://github.com/insightsurge/sandboxPkg/security), choose **Report a vulnerability**. If you can't,
email sandbox@example.com with "sandboxPkg security" in the subject.

Include your sandboxPkg version (`packageVersion("sandboxPkg")`) and a small example with synthetic data.

## What happens next

You'll get an acknowledgement. A confirmed problem is fixed in a new release, described in `NEWS.md`, with credit
if you want it. Please keep the details private until then.
